name: gd_const_n2
prelude:
primrec gd :: "('a::real_inner \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> real list \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "gd g [] x = x"
| "gd g (h # hs) x = gd g hs (x - h *\<^sub>R g x)"
fixes: f :: "'a::real_inner \<Rightarrow> real" and g :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and x0 xs :: 'a
assumes:
interp: "\<And>x y. f y + inner (g y) (x - y) + (1/2) * (norm (g x - g y))\<^sup>2 \<le> f x"
    and opt: "g xs = 0"
concl: f (gd g [1, 1] x0) - f xs \<le> 1/10 * (norm (x0 - xs))\<^sup>2
statement_es: Dos pasos de descenso de gradiente de tamaño 1 (L = 1): f(x₂) − f(x*) ≤ ‖x₀ − x*‖²/10. Es la cota exacta de Drori y Teboulle (2014) para N = 2.
